title: Multilevel non-linear interrupted time series analysis
abstract: arXiv:2511.05725v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in interrupted time series analysis permit characterization of a typical non-linear interruption effect through use of generalized additive models. Concurrently, advances in latent time series modeling allow efficient Bayesian multilevel time series models. We propose to combine these concepts with a hierarchical model selection prior to characterize interruption effects with a multilevel structure, encouraging parsimony and partial pooling while incorporating meaningful variability in causal effects across subpopulations of interest, while allowing poststratification. These models are demonstrated with three applications: 1) the effect of the introduction of the prostate specific antigen test on prostate cancer diagnosis rates by race and age group, 2) the change in stroke or trans-ischemic attack hospitalization rates across Medicare beneficiaries by rurality in the months after the start of the COVID-19 pande

translated_title: 多层次非线性中断时间序列分析
translated_abstract: 中断时间序列分析领域的最新进展使得可以通过广义可加模型来刻画典型的非线性中断效应。与此同时，潜在时间序列建模方面的进展使得高效的贝叶斯多层次时间序列模型成为可能。我们提出将这两个概念与层次模型选择先验相结合，以刻画具有多层次结构的中断效应，在鼓励简洁性和部分汇聚的同时，纳入因果效应在不同目标子群体间有意义的变异性，并支持事后分层。这些模型通过三个应用进行了演示：1）前列腺特异性抗原检测的引入对不同种族和年龄组前列腺癌诊断率的影响；2）COVID-19疫情开始后的几个月内，医疗保险受益人中按城乡属性划分的卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作住院率的变化……
tldr: 本文提出将广义可加模型与贝叶斯多层次潜在时间序列建模相结合，通过层次模型选择先验刻画具有多层次结构的非线性中断效应，在保持简洁性和部分汇聚的同时，允许因果效应在不同子群体间存在变异性并支持事后分层。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes combining generalized additive models with Bayesian multilevel latent time series modeling via hierarchical model selection priors to characterize multilevel non-linear interruption effects, encouraging parsimony and partial pooling while accommodating meaningful variability in causal effects across subpopulations and enabling poststratification.
